div.div:
Response from every command: DB tree
db_id = uid (single) or crdb_guid (AA)
one leaf per cluster: url, network, site, environment, db_uid
users under each leaf: name, user_uid, role_uid, acl_uid
no passwords
stored by the intermediate service
